record.question: What was the major administrative consequence of the Regulating Act of 1773 for British rule in India?
options: It granted full independence to the East India Company from British parliamentary control.
It abolished the East India Company and transferred power directly to the British Crown.
It introduced universal adult franchise in Company territories.
It made the Governor of Bengal the Governor-General of Bengal with supervisory authority over other presidencies.
